description: This file defines the class TestConnectionResponse, which represents the response to a 'TestConnection' command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing JSON, and accessing response data.

classes.name: TestConnectionResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a 'TestConnection' command, including status, connection ID, and test result.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Creates a successful TestConnectionResponse indicating a successful connection test.

methods.name: alreadyCreated
methods.description: Creates a response indicating the connection was already created, thus no test was performed.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a TestConnectionResponse instance.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends JSON payload data to a JsonObjectBuilder, conforming to specified schema version.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with this response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
